reviewer_role: TC perspective; not independent final approval
decision: The v2 contract resolves the v1 TC blockers. It is sufficiently precise for the planned fixed-candidate execution, subject to the separate independent final review and preflight pins.

checks.evidence: G6.2 specifies direct argv with `node --test --test-concurrency=2 --test-reporter=spec` before the complete sorted tests/*.test.mjs operands, no shell and no filter. It also requires package.json scripts.test to remain exactly `node --test tests/*.test.mjs` and to enumerate the same complete glob. Thus runner flags are unambiguously placed while the repository npm-test definition remains unchanged.

The pinned node inventory names the accepted B01 source archive and gate/unit.log entry, pins the entry SHA-256 and byte length, records the extraction regex and UTF-8/multiline rules, and contains exactly 387 unique expected names. Read-only verification recomputed the ZIP entry SHA and byte length and independently counted 387 extracted lines. This is provenance from the accepted historical log, not a new test run.

The contract retains all 387 callbacks, requires exact names, zero skip/fail/cancel/TODO, finite 0..30-second per-callback duration and a 180-second whole-command deadline. It explicitly discloses the two historical aggregate callbacks above 30 seconds and treats concurrency 2 only as a hypothesis.

G6.1 requires fresh accepted G1-G5 execution (351 Python cases plus targeted 48 B01 Node cases) through the unchanged G5 runner, preserving its separate subprocess deadlines, exact inventories, lifecycle cleanup, and no-skip criteria. Previously accepted reports do not substitute for fresh execution.

The gate requires sequential build/plugin/source verification, exact ten output-path/hash comparison after rebuild, unchanged source/dependency/original-input pins, and makes UI omission conditional on explicit inventory, connection and output checks. Drift triggers scope reassessment rather than a waiver.

The pinned route matrix retains absent endpoints and states AT-21 is partial and original AT-01..AT-32 remain not executed. It prohibits claiming execution, artifacts/logs/images/device behavior, corporate SSO or B03/B04/B09 completion from this regression gate.

v1_resolution.resolution: V2 moves flags before operands, pins an exact accepted SPEC inventory derived from historical archive bytes, and clarifies Python distribution counts separately from Node lock/direct dependency records. The v1 review remains historical and unchanged.

residual_risk: Concurrency 2 may not bring every historical aggregate callback below 30 seconds; the gate must fail if any exact callback exceeds the existing limit.
This contract is a test-execution plan, not a claim that the command, build, or any G6 phase has run or passed.
No original AT case, corporate identity provider, production environment, remaining B03-B13 behavior, or missing OpenAPI endpoint is accepted by this review.

read_only_validation: Recomputed SHA-256 for the contract, node inventory, matrix, source baseline, package.json, and prior v1 review inputs.
Opened the pinned historical ZIP entry, verified its recorded SHA-256 and byte length, and checked the inventory contains 387 unique names matching 387 extracted SPEC lines.
